page_title: MCI 0-2 LIV | Manchester City v Liverpool 23/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Arne Slot decides to make a substitution. Trent Alexander-Arnold will be replaced by Jarell Quansah (Liverpool).
90+1' Substitution. Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) on for Mohamed Salah.
90+1' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' 5:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target. The total number of attempts is 16:8.
87' Liverpool keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
84' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

84' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Now Liverpool have a corner.
79' The referee signals a substitution. Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Luis Diaz.
78' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nico as he is replaced by Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City).
77' It will be a substitution. Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) is ready to enter the pitch as Omar Marmoush walks off.
77' Pep Guardiola has decided to substitute Nathan Ake and he is replaced by Ruben Dias (Manchester City).
77' A quickly taken corner by Manchester City.
77' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester City.

76' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
74' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andrew Robertson.
73' Here is a change. Curtis Jones is going off and Arne Slot gives the last tactical orders to Wataru Endo (Liverpool).
72' The shot by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Alisson.
72' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
69' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
66' Substitution. Kevin De Bruyne is replaced by James McAtee (Manchester City).
65' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner but it's cleared.

64' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the top right corner, but Ederson has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The referee points to the corner flag and Liverpool will take a corner.
62' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z.
62' Liverpool force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
58' Manchester City have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
58' Celebrations are cut short for Liverpool as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
58' The Liverpool players halt their celebrations as referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

56' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Dominik Szoboszlai, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:3.
55' Liverpool show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
51' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) commits a foul and Anthony Taylor immediately signals a free kick.
50' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
48' Savinho (Manchester City) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester City comes to nothing. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. Manchester City will take a throw-in.
42' The corner is swung in but Manchester City can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
41' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester City.
41' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Omar Marmoush (Manchester City).
40' Anthony Taylor blows for a foul after Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Manchester City are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

37' 0 - 2 Goal! Great link up play between Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) and Mohamed Salah gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom right corner. 0:2.
36' Liverpool take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

35' The referee signals a corner kick to Liverpool. Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
33' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
31' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
31' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
30' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sees his mid-range free kick perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.

29' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) brings his opponent down. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester City earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
29' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
28' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
26' Neat passing move from Liverpool in order to create new attacking opportunities.
25' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and it's Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Manchester City are awarded a free kick.
23' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Alisson was alert and made a comfortable save.
23' The resulting set piece from Manchester City is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
22' The ball is cleared after Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
21' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
19' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
16' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).
14' 0 - 1 Goal! Dominik Szoboszlai passes the ball to Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Ederson couldn't do anything about it. 0:1.
14' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Corner kick. Liverpool will have an opportunity.
12' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
12' Liverpool move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
9' Rough tackle by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Manchester City.

8' That didn't go as planned! Phil Foden (Manchester City) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Alisson, who easily kept it out.
8' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul. Manchester City have a free kick.
5' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) heads on.
5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Luis Diaz (Liverpool).
4' Manchester City fail to score from a corner as Alisson (Liverpool) leaps to collect the ball.
3' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

3' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
2' The linesman raises his flag. Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is adjudged offside.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Liverpool will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Anthony Taylor.
